SELECT ci.checklist_item_id AS checklistItemId, ci.contents AS contents, ci.category AS category,
FROM analysis_report_checklist_items rci
INNER JOIN checklist_items ci ON ci.checklist_item_id = rci.checklist_item_id
WHERE rci.analysis_report_checklist_id = #{reportChecklistId}
ORDER BY CASE WHEN ci.category = 'COMMON' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, ci.checklist_item_id ASC
